about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_grep.py). bad replays the grep JSON-overflow class of references/target-class.json: it throws the real Ripgrep JSON record exceeded line. good narrows the scope first, filters, reruns chunked, merges the hits, then prints the chunked report it promises.

pairs.bad: throw 'Ripgrep JSON record exceeded N bytes grepping the whole tree with no scope'
pairs.good: $h = Get-Content -LiteralPath hits.txt -Raw; 'narrow scope chunked search PASS'

pairs.bad: throw 'Ripgrep JSON record exceeded N bytes grepping the whole repo with no glob'
pairs.good: $h = Get-Content -LiteralPath hits.txt -Raw; 'glob narrow rerun PASS two chunks'

pairs.bad: throw 'Ripgrep JSON record exceeded N bytes finding the spawn guard across the whole tree'
pairs.good: $h = Get-Content -LiteralPath hits.txt -Raw; 'narrow rerun PASS skills path'

pairs.bad: throw 'Ripgrep JSON record exceeded N bytes on an unfiltered grep in center'
throw 'Ripgrep JSON record exceeded N bytes on a broad regex grep with no literal'
throw 'Ripgrep JSON record exceeded N bytes locating the keeper check with an unfiltered sweep'
pairs.good: $l = Get-Content -LiteralPath listing.txt -Raw; 'glob type filter PASS lines'

pairs.bad: throw 'Ripgrep JSON record exceeded N bytes on a single grep over 8 repos'
throw 'Ripgrep JSON record exceeded N bytes on an unbounded grep with no hit limit'
throw 'Ripgrep JSON record exceeded N bytes counting callers with a single call in forge'
throw 'Ripgrep JSON record exceeded N bytes searching docs in works with no scope'
pairs.good: $l = Get-Content -LiteralPath listing.txt -Raw; 'scope filter chunked PASS path'

pairs.bad: throw 'Ripgrep JSON record exceeded N bytes finding the lane writer with a broad regex in asset-vault'
throw 'Ripgrep JSON record exceeded N bytes reporting a sweep over center plus works with no chunks'
